title: MM-PRM: Enhancing Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning with Scalable Step-Level Supervision
authors_zh: Lingxiao Du、Fanqing Meng、Zongkai Liu、Zhixiang Zhou、Ping Luo、Qiaosheng Zhang、Wenqi Shao
paper_type_zh: 推理轨迹、搜索或测试时计算研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计 rollout、选择器、预算、数据谱系与复现边界的读者
one_line: An OmegaPRM-style multimodal pipeline that turns answer-judged rollout success rates into soft step labels and trains an 8B PRM, while releasing the seed data and checkpoint but not the reported annotation trees.
该条目将推理轨迹、搜索选择或测试时计算作为可审计的研究对象；未披露字段已明确标为 unknown。
why: It makes the chain from multimodal rollouts to step rewards explicit and shows why Monte Carlo value, final-answer judgment, learned PRM score, and Best-of-N selection must be audited as separate contracts.
inclusion_reason: Converts multimodal MCTS rollouts and answer-judged terminal outcomes into per-step Monte Carlo soft labels, then uses a learned PRM to rank Best-of-N reasoning paths.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multimodal mathematical reasoning can fail in the middle of an otherwise plausible chain. Final-answer supervision records only whether the completed response matches a reference and cannot identify which intermediate transition made the path unrecoverable. MM-PRM studies whether such outcome feedback can be expanded into scalable process supervision without human step annotation.

The work must be read as three different data layers. First, MM-K12 supplies 10,000 image-question-answer seed problems. Second, an offline multimodal MCTS pipeline generates reasoning trees and assigns Monte Carlo values to partial paths. Third, those soft values train an 8B process reward model whose scores rank candidate paths at inference time. The seed rows, tree nodes, learned PRM outputs, and benchmark answers are not interchangeable objects.

The release boundary is narrower than the paper's data-generation claim. The official Hugging Face dataset exposes the 10,000-row MM-K12 seed set, the model hub exposes the MM-PRM checkpoint, and GitHub exposes construction and evaluation code. The reported approximately 747,000 step annotations, tree topology, and sampled PRM training records are not downloadable from the checked official locations.

多模态数学推理可能在一条表面合理的链条中途出错。最终答案监督只记录完整回答是否与参考答案匹配，无法指出究竟是哪一个中间转移使推理变得不可恢复。MM-PRM 考察的是：能否在不进行人工步骤标注的情况下，把这类结果反馈扩展为可规模化的过程监督。

该工作必须按三层数据区分理解。第一层，MM-K12 提供 10,000 个图像-问题-答案种子样本。第二层，离线多模态 MCTS 流程生成推理树，并给部分路径赋予 Monte Carlo 值。第三层，这些软标签用于训练 8B 过程奖励模型，再由模型在推理时对候选路径排序。种子记录、树节点、PRM 输出与 benchmark 答案不是可互换的数据对象。

公开边界比论文的数据生成声称更窄。官方 Hugging Face 数据集发布了 10,000 行 MM-K12 种子数据，模型仓库发布了 MM-PRM 检查点，GitHub 提供了构造与评估代码；但论文报告的约 747,000 个步骤标注、树拓扑和采样后的 PRM 训练记录，并未出现在已检查的官方下载位置。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
MM-PRM turns terminal answer judgments into step-level soft targets through an OmegaPRM-style search. MM-Policy generates multiple continuations from a reasoning prefix. Each completed continuation is compared with the reference answer by a Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct judge in the released code. A node's Monte Carlo value is the fraction of those continuations judged correct. Binary-search expansion follows failed continuations to locate an earlier prefix where future success collapses.

This value is not a direct label that the immediately preceding step is logically valid. It estimates the probability that the rollout policy and answer judge can still reach an accepted final answer from a prefix. It therefore mixes local reasoning quality with problem difficulty, future-sampling quality, candidate diversity, and judge error. The paper deliberately retains the real-valued Monte Carlo score as a soft label rather than thresholding it into a binary step label.

The learned PRM has a separate interface. Given the image/question and an ordered reasoning trace, a special prm marker token is inserted after every step. At each marker, the model produces Yes and No logits; the normalized Yes probability is the step score. During Best-of-N inference, an aggregation rule compresses the score vector for each of 16 candidate paths into one path score, and the highest-ranked path supplies the answer.

Thus the complete feedback chain is: reference answer -> final-answer judge -> rollout outcomes -> node Monte Carlo soft labels -> learned per-step PRM scores -> path aggregation and selection. No link in this chain should be treated as a human proof-validity annotation.

MM-PRM 通过类 OmegaPRM 搜索，将终局答案判定转换为步骤级软目标。MM-Policy 从某个推理前缀生成多个后续补全。在公开代码中，每个完整补全由 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 裁判其是否与参考答案语义一致。节点的 Monte Carlo 值是被判为正确的补全占比。二分搜索再沿失败补全向内展开，定位“从哪个较早前缀开始，未来成功率明显崩落”。

这个值不是“紧邻的上一步逻辑有效”的直接标签。它估计的是：在给定前缀后，当前 rollout 策略和答案裁判器仍能得到可接受最终答案的概率。因而，该值同时受局部推理质量、问题难度、后续采样质量、候选多样性与裁判误差影响。论文保留实值 Monte Carlo 分数作为软标签，而不把它阈值化为二值步骤标签。

训练后的 PRM 又有独立的输入输出契约。对图像/问题和有序推理轨迹，系统在每一步后插入特殊 prm 标记 token。模型在每个标记位置输出 Yes/No logits，归一化后的 Yes 概率就是步骤分数。在 Best-of-N 推理中，聚合函数将每条候选路径的分数向量压缩为一个路径分，再从 16 条候选中选择最高分路径的答案。

因而，完整反馈链是：参考答案 -> 最终答案裁判 -> rollout 结果 -> 节点 Monte Carlo 软标签 -> 学习式逐步 PRM 分数 -> 路径聚合与选择。这条链上的任何一环都不应被当作人工证明有效性标注。

title: Method
方法
html:
The construction has four auditable stages.

  1. MM-Policy construction. The appendix lists 16 public data sources totaling 5,135,768 examples. Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct restructures solutions into explicit steps and answers. InternVL2.5-8B is then fine-tuned with its vision encoder frozen; the experiment section describes approximately 4 million cleaned examples, one epoch, batch size 128, and learning rate 4e-5. The difference between the appendix total and the reported used count is not itemized.
  2. Seed and tree generation. MM-K12 contributes 10,000 multimodal K-12 problems, reported as 5,000 fill-in-the-blank and 5,000 multiple-choice questions, plus a separate 500-item test set. For each seed, MM-Policy samples structured continuations. The paper uses temperature 1.0, top-k 50, top-p 0.9, c_puct 0.125, 16 rollouts per Monte Carlo estimate, at most 200 search expansions, and at most 1,000 total rollouts. A text-only Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct prompt judges terminal answer equivalence; binary search expands failed branches while preserving the image in the rollout model's context.
  3. Tree-to-record sampling and PRM training. The released serialization code defines tree fields for partial_solution, mc_value, visit_count, judged-correct and judged-incorrect rollouts, and children; the generated paper-run trees themselves are not released. The traversal script removes roots with MC 0 or 1, ends negative paths at MC 0, drops paths of at most 10 words, deduplicates process strings, and balances retained positive leaves against negatives. A formatted training item contains an image, a Question/Process conversation, and the list of step labels. The paper reports PRM initialization from MM-Policy, one epoch, batch size 512, and learning rate 4e-6.
  4. Best-of-N evaluation. Each policy produces 16 candidate traces. MM-PRM emits one score per prm marker token, and Min, Average, Max, SumLogPr, SumLogOdds, or MeanOdds converts the sequence to a path score. The selected final answer is evaluated on MM-K12, OlympiadBench, MathVista, MathVerse, and MathVision.

The public recipe is not an immutable paper-run manifest. run_data_pipeline.sh matches the paper's 200-search/1,000-rollout caps but leaves the policy model at the unresolved literal /path/to/model; direct invocation of run_data_pipeline.py defaults to only 20 searches and 200 rollouts. The public PRM training shell uses three epochs and learning rate 2e-6 rather than the paper's one epoch and 4e-6.

这一构造流程可分为四个可审计阶段。

  1. MM-Policy 构建。 附录列出 16 个公开数据源，合计 5,135,768 个样本。Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 将原解重组为显式步骤和最终答案，随后对 InternVL2.5-8B 进行微调，并冻结视觉编码器。实验部分称实际使用约 400 万个清洗样本，训练 1 个 epoch，batch size 128，学习率 4e-5；但没有逐项解释附录总数与实际使用量之间的差额。
  2. 种子与树生成。 MM-K12 提供 10,000 个多模态 K-12 数学问题，论文称其由 5,000 个填空题和 5,000 个选择题组成，另有 500 题独立测试集。对每个种子，MM-Policy 采样结构化后续。论文设置温度 1.0、top-k 50、top-p 0.9、c_puct 0.125，每次 Monte Carlo 估计生成 16 条 rollout，最多展开 200 次搜索，每题总 rollout 不超过 1,000。文本形式的 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 提示判定终局答案等价性；二分搜索展开失败分支，而图像仍保留在 rollout 模型的上下文中。
  3. 树到记录的采样与 PRM 训练。 公开的序列化代码定义了 partial_solution、mc_value、visit_count、裁判正确/错误 rollout 及子节点等树字段；论文运行生成的树本身并未发布。遍历脚本移除 MC 为 0 或 1 的根，在 MC 为 0 时结束负路径，丢弃不超过 10 个词的路径，按 process 字符串去重，再将保留的正叶子下采样到不超过负路径数。格式化训练样本包含图像、Question/Process 对话与步骤标签列表。论文报告 PRM 从 MM-Policy 初始化，训练 1 个 epoch，batch size 512，学习率 4e-6。
  4. Best-of-N 评估。 每个策略为每题生成 16 条候选轨迹。MM-PRM 在每个 prm 标记 token 处输出一个分数，再由 Min、Average、Max、SumLogPr、SumLogOdds 或 MeanOdds 压缩为路径分。选中路径的最终答案在 MM-K12、OlympiadBench、MathVista、MathVerse 和 MathVision 上评估。

公开配方不是不可变的论文运行清单。run_data_pipeline.sh 与论文一样使用 200 次搜索/1,000 次 rollout 上限，但策略模型路径仍是 /path/to/model；如果直接调用 run_data_pipeline.py，默认值则只有 20 次搜索和 200 次 rollout。公开 PRM 训练脚本使用 3 个 epoch 和 2e-6 学习率，与论文的 1 个 epoch 和 4e-6 不同。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports approximately 747,000 MCTS-derived step annotations. The released MM-PRM checkpoint's all_results.json independently records 747,779 training samples, one completed epoch, and a training loss, so the model artifact is consistent with a training run of that scale. This metadata does not expose the rows, trees, labels, source IDs, or selection decisions that produced the checkpoint.

Under Best-of-16, the paper reports that MM-Policy accuracy rises from 33.92 to 42.80 on MM-K12 and from 15.41 to 24.00 on OlympiadBench after MM-PRM selection. InternVL2.5-8B rises from 27.01 to 37.80 on MM-K12. The soft-label ablation reports 42.8 with MeanOdds versus 37.0 for hard labels, while other aggregators show different absolute results. These are downstream selection results, not evidence that every step label is correct or that the released seed set has clean provenance.

The official artifact set is concrete but partial. MM-K12 is a public 10,000-row, single-split dataset with id, question, answer, and image; its card declares MIT. MM-PRM is a public 8B InternVL-family checkpoint whose configuration includes the prm marker token and whose card declares MIT. The GitHub repository is MIT-licensed and contains the MCTS, traversal, formatting, PRM training, and evaluation code. It contains no paper-run annotation-tree archive or sampled process-label dataset.

A qualitative paper example assigns high scores to two early geometry steps and a low score to a later erroneous step. It illustrates the intended interface but is one selected example and cannot establish calibration, false-positive rates, or transfer reliability.

论文报告约 747,000 个由 MCTS 生成的步骤标注。公开 MM-PRM 检查点中的 all_results.json 另外记录了 747,779 个训练样本、1 个已完成 epoch 和训练损失，因此模型产物与该规模的训练运行相符。但这些元数据不会暴露生成检查点的具体记录、树、标签、来源 ID 或选择决策。

在 Best-of-16 设置下，论文报告 MM-Policy 经 MM-PRM 选择后，在 MM-K12 上从 33.92 提升到 42.80，在 OlympiadBench 上从 15.41 提升到 24.00；InternVL2.5-8B 在 MM-K12 上从 27.01 提升到 37.80。软标签消融中，MeanOdds 的结果为 42.8，硬标签为 37.0，其他聚合器的绝对结果并不相同。这些是下游路径选择结果，不是“每个步骤标签均正确”或“公开种子数据来源干净”的证据。

官方产物具体但不完整。MM-K12 是公开的 10,000 行单分割数据集，字段为 id、question、answer 和 image，数据卡声明 MIT。MM-PRM 是公开的 8B InternVL 系检查点，配置中包含 prm 标记 token，模型卡同样声明 MIT。GitHub 仓库使用 MIT，并提供 MCTS、树遍历、数据格式化、PRM 训练与评估代码；但其中没有论文运行的标注树归档或采样后的过程-标签数据集。

论文的一个定性几何示例为前两步赋予高分，为后续错误步骤赋予低分。这只能说明预期接口的行为，由于它是单个选定示例，无法证明校准、误报率或跨模型迁移可靠性。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
MM-PRM adapts automated process supervision from text-only mathematics to image-conditioned reasoning. The construction preserves the image for the rollout policy, uses an OmegaPRM-style tree to search partial multimodal solutions, and trains a multimodal critic on real-valued continuation-success estimates. This is more specific than applying an outcome reward only at the end of a response.

Two design choices define the contribution. First, binary-search expansion spends rollouts around failed paths instead of exhaustively labeling every prefix. Second, the PRM is trained with continuous Monte Carlo targets and emits a score after every prm marker token, enabling several explicit path-aggregation rules at Best-of-N inference.

The method does not introduce direct human step judgments, a symbolic visual-math verifier, or a guarantee that a high Monte Carlo value means the current step is valid. Its novelty is an automated multimodal outcome-to-process conversion and a released scorer, not an externally grounded proof-validity dataset.

MM-PRM 将原本主要面向纯文本数学的自动过程监督扩展到图像条件推理。该构造在 rollout 策略中保留图像，通过类 OmegaPRM 树搜索部分多模态解，再以连续的“后续成功率”估计训练多模态 critic。这比仅在回答末尾使用结果奖励更细化。

两个设计构成了主要贡献。第一，二分展开将 rollout 预算集中在失败路径周围，而不是穷举标注每个前缀。第二，PRM 使用连续 Monte Carlo 目标训练，并在每个 prm 标记 token 后输出分数，从而在 Best-of-N 推理中支持多种明确的路径聚合规则。

该方法并未提供直接人工步骤判断、符号式视觉数学验证器，也不保证高 Monte Carlo 值就意味着当前步骤有效。其新意在于将多模态结果反馈自动转换为过程信号，并发布对应评分器，而不是构建外部真值支撑的证明有效性数据集。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The soft target has a narrower meaning than the paper's occasional language of step correctness suggests. It is a continuation-success estimate under MM-Policy, finite sampling, and one answer judge. A sound prefix can score low when future rollouts are weak; a flawed prefix can score high when later continuations repair it or the judge accepts a wrong equivalent. The paper itself notes that MC values also encode difficulty, criticality, and rollout uncertainty.

The terminal verifier is an LLM judgment, not a programmatic solver. In the released omegaprm.py, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct receives the question text, reference answer, and generated answer, but not the image, and is sampled at temperature 0.5. No calibration set, repeated-decision agreement, false-positive/false-negative analysis, or judge-version pin is reported. A separate mllm_as_a_judge.py uses Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct and the image for local-step scoring, but the documented traversal and formatting path does not consume its llm_as_a_judge field; it must not be conflated with the Monte Carlo training labels.

Selection changes the empirical data distribution. Roots with all-success or all-failure rollouts disappear, MC-zero branches terminate negative paths, short paths are removed, identical process strings are deduplicated, and positive leaves are downsampled. Without the paper-run trees and sampled records, the frequency of these decisions, step-depth distribution, class balance, failure coverage, and image/problem source mixture cannot be audited.

Reproduction remains partial. The released model result file supports a 747,779-sample run, but the examples themselves are absent. The paper and public PRM training shell disagree on epoch count and learning rate; the data-generation shell leaves the policy model at the unresolved literal /path/to/model; random seeds and immutable run revisions are missing. The appendix totals 5.14 million policy examples while the experiment section says approximately 4 million were used, with no row-level filtering ledger.

Best-of-N evidence is bounded by candidate quality. The PRM cannot recover a correct solution that was never sampled, and Min, Average, Max, log-probability, and odds aggregators impose different length and error-sensitivity assumptions. Benchmark gains therefore do not establish label validity, calibration, source cleanliness, or general suitability as an RL reward. MM-K12 has only one public 10,000-row split, while the paper's 500-item test mapping, original problem/image sources, decontamination, and upstream licenses remain unknown.

软目标的语义比论文部分段落中“步骤正确性”的表述更窄。它是在 MM-Policy、有限采样和单一答案裁判器下的后续成功率估计。逻辑正确的前缀可能因后续 rollout 较弱而得低分；错误前缀也可能因后续路径将其修复，或裁判器误接受而得高分。论文自身也指出，MC 值还编码了问题难度、步骤关键性和 rollout 不确定性。

终局验证器是 LLM 判定，不是程序化求解器。在公开 omegaprm.py 中，Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 接收问题文本、参考答案和生成答案，但不接收图像，而且采样温度为 0.5。论文和发布均未报告校准集、重复判定一致率、假阳性/假阴性分析或裁判模型版本锁定。另一个 mllm_as_a_judge.py 使用 Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct 和图像对局部步骤评分，但文档中的树遍历与格式化路径并不使用其 llm_as_a_judge 字段；因此不能将它与 Monte Carlo 训练标签混为一谈。

选择会改变经验数据分布。所有 rollout 全成功或全失败的根会被移除，MC 为 0 的分支终止负路径，短路径被丢弃，相同 process 字符串被去重，正叶子还会下采样。由于缺少论文运行的树和采样记录，这些决策的频率、步骤深度分布、类别平衡、失败覆盖和图像/问题来源混合无法审计。

复现性仍然只是部分的。公开模型结果文件支持“进行过 747,779 样本训练”，但样本本身不存在于发布中。论文和公开 PRM 训练脚本在 epoch 数与学习率上不一致；数据生成脚本中的策略模型路径还是占位符；随机种子和不可变运行修订版未披露。附录统计 514 万个策略数据样本，实验段则称使用约 400 万个，没有行级过滤台账。

Best-of-N 证据受候选质量上限约束。如果正确解从未被采样，PRM 无法恢复它；Min、Average、Max、对数概率和 odds 聚合器对长度与错误敏感度的假设也不同。因此，benchmark 收益不能证明标签有效、分数经过校准、来源干净，或者它适合普遍作为 RL 奖励。MM-K12 公开仓库只有一个 10,000 行分割，论文的 500 题测试映射、原始问题/图像来源、去污染和上游许可均为 unknown。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Rollout / Search / Test-Time Trace Data track, MM-PRM is useful because it exposes the full conceptual conversion from search traces to a selector: multimodal seed -> rollout tree -> terminal judgment -> node value -> sampled process path -> learned step scorer -> Best-of-N ranking. This is a reusable schema for studying how test-time search artifacts become process-supervision data.

The released code supports controlled reconstruction studies. Researchers can replace the terminal judge, vary rollout budgets and search priorities, compare soft and hard targets, preserve rather than balance failure branches, or test aggregation-induced length bias. The checkpoint provides a deployable scorer for cross-model transfer experiments, while MM-K12 supplies a public seed interface.

Reuse should retain the contracts as separate columns or artifacts. Store raw image/question/reference data, exact policy and judge revisions, all rollouts and judge responses, tree topology and search statistics, sampled/filtered paths, per-step MC labels, PRM scores, aggregation rule, and selected terminal answer. Without this ledger, a downstream user cannot tell whether a result comes from better generation, more search, answer-judge behavior, label selection, PRM generalization, or aggregation.

The public package is therefore best treated as a recipe plus seed set and checkpoint, not as an open 747k process-label dataset. Rebuilding the missing annotation layer is necessary before claims about data composition, label quality, failure coverage, or reproducibility can be audited.

对 Rollout / Search / Test-Time Trace Data 轨道而言，MM-PRM 的价值在于它展示了从搜索轨迹到选择器的完整概念转换：多模态种子 -> rollout 树 -> 终局判定 -> 节点价值 -> 采样过程路径 -> 学习式步骤评分器 -> Best-of-N 排序。这是研究“如何将测试时搜索产物变成过程监督数据”的可复用 schema。

公开代码可用于受控重建研究。研究者可替换终局裁判器，调整 rollout 预算与搜索优先级，比较软/硬目标，保留而不平衡失败分支，或检验聚合函数引起的长度偏差。公开检查点可作为跨模型迁移实验的可部署评分器，MM-K12 则提供公开种子接口。

复用时应把各契约保存为分离的字段或产物：原始图像/问题/参考答案，精确的策略和裁判模型修订版，所有 rollout 与裁判响应，树拓扑与搜索统计，被采样/过滤的路径，逐步 MC 标签，PRM 分数，聚合规则和选中的终局答案。没有这份台账，下游用户就无法区分收益究竟来自更好的生成、更多的搜索、答案裁判行为、标签选择、PRM 泛化还是聚合。

因此，当前公开包最适合被视为“配方 + 种子集 + 检查点”，而不是开放的 747k 过程标签数据集。只有重建缺失的标注层，才能审计数据组成、标签质量、失败覆盖与复现性声称。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep four signals separate: reference-answer match, binary rollout judgment, node Monte Carlo value, and the learned PRM's per-step Yes probability.
  • A node label measures continuation success under MM-Policy and the Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct judge; it is not a direct human verdict on local logical validity.
  • The verified releases are MM-K12 seeds, recipe code, and an 8B checkpoint; the paper-run trees and 747,779 sampled PRM records are absent.
  • Check selection effects from root filtering, MC-zero termination, short-path removal, deduplication, and positive-path downsampling before reusing regenerated labels.
  • Treat Best-of-N gains as selector evidence only; candidate coverage, aggregation, judge calibration, provenance, split mapping, and paper/script mismatches remain audit boundaries.

• 必须区分四种信号：参考答案匹配、rollout 二值判定、节点 Monte Carlo 值，以及学习后 PRM 的逐步 Yes 概率。
  • 节点标签衡量的是 MM-Policy 与 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 裁判器下的后续成功率，不是人工对局部逻辑有效性的直接结论。
  • 经核验的发布产物是 MM-K12 种子、配方代码和 8B 检查点；论文运行的树和 747,779 个采样 PRM 记录未发布。
  • 重新生成标签前，应检查根过滤、MC-zero 终止、短路径移除、去重和正路径下采样引入的选择效应。
  • Best-of-N 收益只是选择器证据；候选覆盖、聚合方式、裁判校准、数据来源、split 映射及论文/脚本差异仍是审计边界。

value.html: Offline OmegaPRM-style MCTS over multimodal reasoning prefixes, with vLLM generation and binary-search expansion of failed rollouts.

value_zh.html: 在多模态推理前缀上的离线 OmegaPRM 风格 MCTS，使用 vLLM 生成并对失败 rollouts 做二分搜索扩展。

value.html: A Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct final-answer judge in the released construction code supplies binary rollout outcomes; their success fraction becomes a Monte Carlo soft label. The learned MM-PRM then emits a Yes-class probability at each prm marker token. These are related but distinct feedback stages.

value_zh.html: 已发布构建代码中的 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 最终答案评审提供二元 rollout 结果；其成功比例成为蒙特卡洛软标签。已学习的 MM-PRM 随后在每个 prm 标记 token 处发出 Yes 类概率。这些是相关但不同的反馈阶段。

value.html: A completed rollout is successful when the text-only answer judge returns Yes for semantic agreement with the reference answer; the public code queries at temperature 0.5 and does not pass the image to this judge.

value_zh.html: 当纯文本答案评审对与参考答案的语义一致返回 Yes 时，已完成 rollout 为成功；公开代码以 temperature 0.5 查询，且不将图像传给该评审。

value.html: MM-Policy and MM-PRM are initialized from InternVL2.5-8B; the public Hugging Face checkpoint identifies OpenGVLab/InternVL2_5-8B as its base.

value_zh.html: MM-Policy 与 MM-PRM 从 InternVL2.5-8B 初始化；公开 Hugging Face checkpoint 将其基座标识为 OpenGVLab/InternVL2_5-8B。

value.html: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct restructures policy-training solutions in the paper and serves as the final-answer judge in the released MCTS code. A separate Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct local-step judging script exists but is not part of the documented main tree-to-training-data path.

value_zh.html: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 在论文中重构策略训练解答，并在已发布 MCTS 代码中担任最终答案评审。存在单独的 Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct 局部步骤评审脚本，但不属于所记录的主树到训练数据路径。

value.html: MM-Policy generates structured chain-of-thought continuations from image-question prefixes; OmegaPRM-style search selectively expands failed branches.

value_zh.html: MM-Policy 从图像-问题前缀生成结构化思维链续写；OmegaPRM 风格搜索选择性地扩展失败分支。

value.html: Paper settings are temperature 1.0, top-k 50, top-p 0.9, c_puct 0.125, 16 rollouts per Monte Carlo estimate, up to 200 search expansions, and at most 1,000 total rollouts per problem.

value_zh.html: 论文设置为 temperature 1.0、top-k 50、top-p 0.9、c_puct 0.125、每次蒙特卡洛估计 16 次 rollouts、最多 200 次搜索扩展，以及每题至多 1,000 次总 rollouts。

value.html: The released traversal keeps only roots with Monte Carlo value strictly between 0 and 1, stops a path at mc_value <= 0, removes paths of at most 10 words, deduplicates identical process strings, and downsamples positive leaves to at most the number of negative paths.

value_zh.html: 已发布遍历仅保留蒙特卡洛值严格介于 0 与 1 之间的根，在 mc_value <= 0 处停止路径，移除至多 10 个词的路径，对相同过程字符串去重，并将正叶降采样至至多为负路径的数量。

value.html: Up to 200 search expansions or 1,000 rollouts per seed problem are reported; total token count, GPU-hours, and generation seeds are unknown.

value_zh.html: 报告每道种子题最多 200 次搜索扩展或 1,000 次 rollouts；总 token 计数、GPU-hours 与生成 seeds 未知。

value.html: The paper initializes the PRM from MM-Policy and reports one epoch, batch size 512, and learning rate 4e-6; the public training shell instead specifies three epochs and learning rate 2e-6.
